title: Loved it... until it wouldn't work
text:
Loved it... until it wouldn't work. LOVE it! Beautiful and stylish! Compliments my decor and living room perfectly! I got a great deal on a "used" one too (which just meant damaged box but still brand new clock). Super happy and pleased with this purchase :)

*Update quit working after a few hours :(

product_metadata.title: SEI Furniture Wall Clock, Metallic
features: Wall clock has classic numeral design with a silver painted center this piece adds style and function to any room
Overall dimensions measure 30.5 inches wide x 1.5 inches deep x 30 inches high
Constructed of black powder coated metal | Requires 1 AA battery. Assembly required
Note : Users must carefully match up the hole opening on the hand first (BEFORE pushing in the hand) into hexagonal shape of the hole opening, then do the same to the minute hand afterwards
description: Whether you add this classic oversized wall clock to your living room, den or home office, you will love the contrast of contemporary vintage that this piece offers. With a thin frame and perfectly placed roman numerals, this clock is not only functional, but stylish as well. This clock will add a simple elegance to your home that cannot be found elsewhere; Requires 1 AA Battery (not included. Dimensions include: Overall: 30.5" W x 1.5" D x 30" H. This one-of-a-kind item weighs approximately 8 pounds. Only quality materials and manufacturing will do. Product materials include: Materials: Metal. Assembly required. Made in China.
